beat_plan: Establish: show one action and its observable consequence at readable scale
Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail
Payoff: measured zoom with one clear final identity

direction.camera: Guide attention with stepwise workflow; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: show one action and its observable consequence at readable scale; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with visible action; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with measured zoom.
direction.lighting: even interface fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: crisp UI surfaces and sparse annotations; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around proof rail; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use stepwise workflow,visible action,before after,clear consequence,proof rail,measured zoom as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
